notes:
Summary: PullMate is building a GitHub-style PR review assistant (diff summarization + comment generation + reranking). Primary goals: low-latency streaming in the IDE, deterministic model/version pinning, and high-quality comment ranking for multi-reviewer workflows.

Recent activity:
- 2026-02-12: intro call (Jordan) — product fit looks strong, team already has small internal copilot.
- 2026-02-20: demo of Redwood hosted API + streaming (recorded). Fireflies: ff_20260218_7b2f.
- 2026-02-25: security questionnaire sent, asked for SOC2 in-scope controls and KMS options.
- 2026-03-01: SE deep-dive with Priya — validated batching, kv-cache idea, model pinning requirements.
- 2026-03-02: pricing call; asked for committed throughput option.

POC ask (what PullMate wants):
- 2-week POC with Dedicated pool (prefer GPU-resident KV cache)
- Run synthetic PR workload: 50 active devs, ~30 PRs/min, average diff size ~120 lines
- End-to-end latency targets: streaming reconnect <100ms, token latency <40ms median, end-to-end comment generation <1.2s for short comments
- Support model pinning per-repo + ability to route fallback to cheaper quantized variant on overload

Security / privacy notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) and SCIM provisioning.
- Legal wants explicit data retention window + ability to disable logging of full diffs.
- Prefer VPC with customer KMS; air-gapped not required but data residency in US.

Product & technical preferences:
- Prefer models with strong code understanding (open-source or Redwood curated).
- Need streaming token-level outputs for IDE copilot (VS Code extension).
- Require model version pinning and deterministic rollbacks for experiments.
- Want reranking API that returns scores + top-k reasons for audit.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need the assistant to feel native in the IDE — streaming + tiny latency spikes kill UX."
- "If fallback changes the suggestions quality, reviewers get confused — we need predictable rollouts."

Evaluation criteria:
- Quality: comment helpfulness score vs internal baseline (use their eval harness repo: drive:/PullMate/evals/pr_comments.md)
- Performance: median token latency, tail latency, and throughput under 2k concurrent sessions
- Cost: per-comment and per-embedding unit economics for production traffic

Open items / blockers:
- Legal sign-off on retention + logging controls (SEC-401 open)
- Need Redwood to supply a pricing worksheet for dedicated GPU bursts
- Validation of <40ms token latency in their region (NA-east)

Next steps agreed:

- PullMate to provide sample PR corpus and consent for masked data by 2026-03-10.
- SE perf run scheduled week of 2026-03-15 (Priya leading).
